rules: Statement digests include predicate_ref, relation_id, semantics_id, program_hash, result_schema_hash and a domain tag.
Each entry is verified by its own verifier; acceptance is the conjunction of required entries; no claim-kind upgrade.
ledger-current-context entries are recomputed by the consumer validator from its ScriptContext.
Anchor values are resolved by the consumer from its pinned profile; bundle-supplied roots are refused.
universal-property entries are deploy-time certificates bound to program_hash, property_hash, semantics, bounds and checker id.
Aggregation/recursion is a separate relation exposing its covered list; it changes no entry's kind, anchor or freshness.
unsupported, unknown, timeout, missing entry and version mismatch fail closed.
Accepted predicate/relation/verifier set is committed by contract state at creation; changes need a program-defined authorized migration.
Permissionless production; acceptance follows the contract-committed objective policy only.
